reddit.title: Improving Colony Music Experience in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the way music transitions in Provincia. Previously, our colony music would have noticeable hitches at the seams, especially during transitions between day, night, and combat. Now, with a new long equal-power self-crossfade technique, these transitions are seamless, enhancing your gameplay experience. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
